Workflow.Name: Flux test
Workflow.Definition:
"@@ConnectionString: ''
@@Type: 'Local'
@@DesktopType: 'local'
@@DisplayName: 'Ordinateur local'
IMPORT 'controlRepo.appmask' AS appmask
IMPORT 'imageRepo.imgrepo' AS imgrepo
@SENSITIVE: []
@INPUT varEntree_EtapeOuvertureNav : { 'Description': '', 'FriendlyName': 'varEntree_EtapeOuvertureNav', 'Type': 'Bool', 'IsOptional': True, 'DefaultValue': True } 
@INPUT varEntree_URLSolidiag : { 'Description': '', 'FriendlyName': 'varEntree_URLSolidiag', 'Type': 'String', 'IsOptional': True, 'DefaultValue': 'https://v2.solidiag.fr' } 
DISABLE Word.LaunchWord.Launch Visible: True Instance=> WordInstance
DISABLE Word.WriteToWord.WriteStartOfDocument Instance: WordInstance Text: $'''Coucou !''' AppendNewLine: False
DISABLE WebAutomation.LaunchChrome.LaunchChrome Url: $'''https://v2.solidiag.fr''' WindowState: WebAutomation.BrowserWindowState.Normal ClearCache: False ClearCookies: False WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60 Timeout: 60 PiPUserDataFolderMode: WebAutomation.PiPUserDataFolderModeEnum.AutomaticProfile TargetDesktop: $'''{\"DisplayName\":\"Ordinateur local\",\"Route\":{\"ServerType\":\"Local\",\"ServerAddress\":\"\"},\"DesktopType\":\"local\"}''' BrowserInstance=> Browser
WebAutomation.LaunchEdge.LaunchEdge Url: $'''https://v2.solidiag.fr''' WindowState: WebAutomation.BrowserWindowState.Normal ClearCache: False ClearCookies: False WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60 Timeout: 60 PiPUserDataFolderMode: WebAutomation.PiPUserDataFolderModeEnum.AutomaticProfile TargetDesktop: $'''{\"DisplayName\":\"Ordinateur local\",\"Route\":{\"ServerType\":\"Local\",\"ServerAddress\":\"\"},\"DesktopType\":\"local\"}''' BrowserInstance=> Browser
WebAutomation.GoToWebPage.GoToWebPage BrowserInstance: Browser Url: $'''https://v2.solidiag.fr/menage/detail/68449/obligatoire/edit''' WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
IF varEntree_EtapeOuvertureNav = $'''true''' THEN
 # Impossible de contrôler les instances des navigateurs déjà présents
 DISABLE Text.Replace Text: varEntree_Prénom TextToFind: `` IsRegEx: True IgnoreCase: True ReplaceWith: $'''\'-\'''' ActivateEscapeSequences: True Result=> PrenomSansEspace
 DISABLE WebAutomation.LaunchEdge.LaunchEdge Url: $'''%varEntree_URLSolidiag%/menage/''' WindowState: WebAutomation.BrowserWindowState.Normal ClearCache: False ClearCookies: False WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60 Timeout: 60 PiPUserDataFolderMode: WebAutomation.PiPUserDataFolderModeEnum.AutomaticProfile TargetDesktop: $'''{\"DisplayName\":\"Ordinateur local\",\"Route\":{\"ServerType\":\"Local\",\"ServerAddress\":\"\"},\"DesktopType\":\"local\"}''' BrowserInstance=> Browser
 WebAutomation.LaunchChrome.LaunchChrome Url: $'''%varEntree_URLSolidiag%/menage/''' WindowState: WebAutomation.BrowserWindowState.Normal ClearCache: False ClearCookies: False WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60 Timeout: 60 PiPUserDataFolderMode: WebAutomation.PiPUserDataFolderModeEnum.AutomaticProfile TargetDesktop: $'''{\"DisplayName\":\"Ordinateur local\",\"Route\":{\"ServerType\":\"Local\",\"ServerAddress\":\"\"},\"DesktopType\":\"local\"}''' BrowserInstance=> Browser
END
"
